titles.title: National Coordination on Resilience for Security Act of 2026
National Coordination on Resilience for Security Act of 2026
A bill to amend the National Security Act of 1947 to require the Federal Government to produce a national resilience strategy, and for other purposes.

action.text: Read twice and referred to the Committee on Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs.

committee.name: Senate Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs
